name: Mini Documentary
summary: A one-minute film: voiceover over real B-roll, a warm film grade, music that carries the emotion, natural sound moments, and serif chapter cards that turn one story into acts.
best_for: Origin stories, how-it's-made pieces, client transformations and case studies, restaurants, makers, travel and nonprofits. 45-120 second pieces built from voiceover plus real footage.
why_it_works: A cold open on the most striking moment (the result or the low point) creates a question in the first 3s that only the story answers. Chapter cards every 12-30s set up acts, so the viewer always knows a turn is coming. Cutting to the music beat every 1.5-3.5s keeps momentum without hype, and natural-sound breaks every 10-15s reset attention. The emotional peak at 70-80% with the swell drives completion and shares.

preview.caption_sample: It started in a garage with one table.
